menu.editDraftPending: Your original change is saved for recovery. Check its result before making another change.
menu.draftTargetCancelled: This order was cancelled. Its old edit was archived and cannot be saved.
menu.draftReadFailed: The saved cart could not be read. Checkout is paused; the previous cart has been retained.
menu.draftSaveFailed: The cart could not be saved. Checkout is paused until its durable save succeeds.
menu.draftDiscardFailed: The saved cart could not be discarded. It has been retained.
menu.draftNeedsReconciliation: The original checkout still needs reconciliation. No new payment was started. Use payment recovery or ask a manager.
menu.draftRecoveryUnavailable: The original checkout could not be verified. Its saved cart remains protected.
menu.draftPending: The original checkout is retained. Confirm its result before starting another payment.
menu.draftRecovered: The original order has been restored.
menu.draftExistingTable: This table already has an active check. Open that check to add items.
menu.draftDeclinedResumed: The payment was declined. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.
menu.draftNotSentResumed: No payment was sent. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.
menu.draftNotChargedResumed: The original payment attempts did not charge the customer. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.

legacyCurrency.title: Confirm the open shift currency
legacyCurrency.message: This shift was opened with an older version. Confirm that its opening cash and transactions were in {{currency}} before continuing. No amounts will be converted.
legacyCurrency.ready: Shift currency confirmed. You can continue to payment.
legacyCurrency.failed: The shift could not be confirmed. Check its currency and enter a manager PIN if required.

menu.editServerUpdate: Order corrections are temporarily unavailable. Check your connection and retry after the server update.
menu.editSyncRequired: The payment or order change has not synced yet. Your cart is saved. Try again shortly.
menu.emptyEditHint: To remove every item, close the editor and cancel the order.
menu.editCanonicalChanged: This order changed on the server. Press “Refresh the order”, then open the order again and make your change. Nothing was charged.
menu.cardRecoveryQuestion: Was the card charged? Check the bank POS for this amount before you answer. Nothing is charged here.
menu.cardRecoveryRegisterNote: This till records card charges through its cash register or terminal, and nothing there shows this card was charged. If the bank POS shows a charge, ask a manager.
menu.cardRecoveryCharged: The card was charged – record it
menu.cardRecoveryNotCharged: The card was NOT charged – back to the cart
menu.checkoutParked: The checkout was set aside and new orders can be taken. Check the bank POS: if the customer was charged, do not charge again; a manager settles it. POS status lists this attempt.
menu.checkoutParkFailed: The checkout could not be set aside. It stays protected; nothing was changed.
menu.checkoutParkApprovalSubtitle: Setting aside a checkout needs the right to void payments. A staff member who has it enters their own PIN. Nothing is charged.
menu.freezeNotSaved: The cart could not be saved for payment, so no payment was started. Press Pay to try again.
menu.orderNotSavedCartKept: The order was not saved and no payment was recorded. The cart is kept: press Pay again. If you already took the money, do not take it again.
menu.freezeReadbackChanged: No payment was started: the till could not save this cart for payment exactly as entered. Select the customer or address again, then press Pay. If it happens again, contact support.
menu.orderConfirmationRefused: The order was not saved: its saved checkout did not match this payment, so pressing Pay again as it is will not help. No payment was recorded and the cart is kept. If you took the money, do not take it again. Select the customer or address again, then press Pay. If it happens again, contact support.
menu.editOrderRefreshed: The order was updated from the server. Open it again and make your change. Nothing was charged.
menu.editRefreshFailed: The order could not be refreshed: a payment or change of it has not reached the server yet, or its payments differ from the server’s. Wait a minute and press “Refresh the order” again. If it keeps failing, ask a manager. Nothing was charged.

checkoutRecovery.title: Operations awaiting recovery
checkoutRecovery.guidance: Original requests remain saved. Internet and current permissions are required. Do not repeat an uncertain payment.
checkoutRecovery.unavailable: Recovery status could not be read. Pending operations have been retained.
checkoutRecovery.approval_required: Cancellation needs fresh staff or manager approval; reopen the original check.
checkoutRecovery.auth_required: Sign in with an authorized staff session to resume.
checkoutRecovery.conflict: The original request requires review before you continue.
checkoutRecovery.originalResultUnconfirmed: The original cancellation could not be confirmed. It remains saved. Reconnect and review the check before continuing.
checkoutRecovery.editRefused: The change was not applied because the order changed in the meantime. Open it again and make the change from the beginning.
checkoutRecovery.editConflict: The saved edit needs review. Reopen the order before continuing.
checkoutRecovery.editReviewUnavailable: The saved edit could not be opened or discarded. Reconnect and check the order again.

reasonCodes.table_cancellation_not_saved: The original table cancellation return has not been saved yet.
reasonCodes.edit_settlement_not_saved: A confirmed order correction is not saved yet. Its original collection or refund is retained.

fixCodes.table_cancellation_not_saved: Recover the original table cancellation. Do not hand back or refund the money again.
fixCodes.edit_settlement_not_saved: Reopen the saved order edit and save the same correction. Do not collect or return money again.

checkoutParked.title: Checkout set aside – check the bank POS
checkoutParked.summary: At {{time}} a manager set aside a checkout of {{amount}} {{currency}} so the till could take orders again. Nothing was recorded for it.
checkoutParked.guidance: Check the bank POS (or TWINT app) for this amount at that time. If the customer was charged, do not charge again: a manager enters the order and records that payment once. If not, nothing more is needed.
